text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0842 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne lower on CBOT soy complex calls. Old crop was expected to open lower on Chicago calls with funds widely expected to cover July shorts. New crop was expected to open C$1 down on inadequate rainfall on the eastern Prairies and some hedge selling expected. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -1.61 Friday from -4.60 Thursday. Canada's dollar rose to C$1.3769 against the U.S. dollar, and fell to 82.49 yen and 1.2553 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.70 to C$1.20 down on overbought conditions.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls as the July-Oct spread was expected to widden out from C$2.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on dry weather on the eastern Prairires.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
